periods.time: Night before the sixth day of Stella's trial

name.zh: 福小莉击败赤蝎与剑狼
name.en: Fu Xiaoli Defeats Red Scorpio and Sword Wolf

periods.location: Village at the foot of Edelberg
periods.summary: After Lambert Rabe defeats a group of bounty hunters, Fu Xiaoli appears in prison clothes and challenges him and Zenichi Kiba. Kiba fights first with Demon Ice Ten-Wolf Formation and an absolute-zero slash, but Xiaoli's martial arts and copied ice counter defeat him. Rabe then uses flash tactics and Death Stinger poison, yet Xiaoli reads his intent, counters poison with poison, and disables him. She asks villagers to treat them and sends her challenge aura up the mountain.
periods.cause: Xiaoli escaped Shenlong Temple confinement to seek strong foreign martial artists and challenge Edelweiss.
periods.process: Kiba surrounds her with ice clones; she evades and breaks them, then survives his trap. Rabe recognizes her as one of the Four Immortals, poisons her with Death Stinger, but she had already understood the true killing intent and uses a counter toxin through a finger strike.
periods.outcome: Kiba and Rabe are defeated before reaching Edelweiss, and Xiaoli announces herself to Stella's group through overwhelming Desperado aura.
periods.significance: Establishes Xiaoli as a Desperado-level threat and redirects the final Edelberg trial from ordinary challengers to a true death match.
